Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1093
Claimant:
Brandon May
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
August 18, 2024
Claim received on a rear-end collision report from the insured's vehicle. The claimant reports neck strain and is not
represented by counsel at this stage.
September 14, 2024
Reviewed the insured's policy and cofnirmed the driver involved is named on the policy. Coverage was in force at the
time of loss, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
September 20, 2024
Spoke with the claimant, who described the impact and the resulitng neck discomfort. The account matched what was
recorded at first notice.
October 17, 2024
Received the photographs from the scene. They confirm the general location and rear-end contact, though some
details are not fully visible in the images.
October 25, 2024
No independent witnesses were identified. The claimant did not provide the other party's details at the scene, and the
claimant joined the claim several days after the collision.
October 31, 2024
Requested prior medical records. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from the information gathered so
far.
November 12, 2024
Reviewed the treatment notes. The injury is consistent with the type and force of the collision, and the treatment
followed a typical course.
November 29, 2024
Inspected the vehicle. A few older scratches were noted that may predate this collision, so the scope of damage
attributable to this impact is still being evaluated.
November 30, 2024
Called the claimant again to go over the account. The claimant gave the same description of events as in earlier
conversations.
March 10, 2025
Treatment has tapered as the claimant improved, consistent with the expected recovery pattern. Reserves were
reviewed against the current status.
March 13, 2025
Claim remains open pending the completion of the damage assessment and a final review of the medical records.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
